title: Subtask competence can hide interface and decision failures
text: Newport’s late-2025 assessment separates text-native coding environments from heterogeneous interfaces and underspecified real-world requests. The useful diagnostic questions concern hidden preferences, observable state and failures across dependent steps—not whether an agent can explain a plausible plan.
qualification: Dated commentary represented in supplied notes. This is not a statement of current product limitations or a quantified reliability model.
